_comment: Local models every Codespace should have WITHOUT uploading: baked into the dev-container image by .github/workflows/devcontainer-image.yml and, if missing at runtime, fetched by the engine on start (see docs/LOCAL_MODELS.md). URL forms: hf://org/repo/file.gguf or a direct https link. min_cores / max_cores (optional) pick the model for the machine the engine runs on; the image bakes every enabled entry.

models.note: Qwen2.5 1.5B Instruct Q4_K_M (~1.0 GB) - fits the 9 s vote budget on a 4-core Codespace
Qwen2.5 0.5B Instruct Q4_K_M (~0.4 GB) - the one that fits the 9 s vote budget on a 2-core Codespace
